mla.name: Rohan Khaunte
mla.portfolio: Cabinet Minister for Tourism, Information Technology, Electronics & Communications
mla.about: Represented Porvorim continuously since 2012 across three consecutive assembly elections. Serves as Cabinet Minister spearheading Goa's digital governance, IT policy modernization, coastal hospitality reforms, and entrepreneurship initiatives.

mp.name: Shripad Yesso Naik
mp.portfolio: Union Minister of State for Power & New and Renewable Energy
mp.about: Elected to the Lok Sabha for six consecutive terms from North Goa since 1999. Serves as Union Minister of State for Power and New & Renewable Energy. Previously held independent charge of the Ministry of AYUSH and served as Union Minister of State for Defence.

key_movements.title: Khaunte Formal BJP Integration
key_movements.desc: Rohan Khaunte joining BJP consolidated both personal and party bases in 2022.

key_movements.title: 2024 Lok Sabha Command
key_movements.desc: Shripad Naik secured a 33.6% victory gap across Porvorim booths.

takeaways: Porvorim is an urban-dominated seat with high digital literacy and high turnout in Salvador do Mundo and Socorro.
Rohan Khaunte holds strong cross-community loyalty, winning both as Independent (2012, 2017) and on BJP ticket (2022).
Penha-de-Franca coastal wards lean moderately competitive between BJP and Congress.
